svg.text: Cut 1,400 mm of 70 x 70 mm treated timber; seal the cut ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bolt-down post anchor: drop the post in, drill through the anchor's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side holes and bolt with two M10 coach bolts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the boxes on the front face (the face toward the turbine):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rectifier box 840 to 960 mm up; controller box 1,030 to 1,230 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Resistor guard on the side face, 540 to 700 mm up, with 50 mm air

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: space all round and nothing that burns within 300 mm above it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fix each box with four stainless screws through its own mounting

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Site: on ground above flood level, at least 1 m from the stream bank.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the post stands upright and does not rock in its anchor.
